status: Cold read-cost regression and original native text/tool memory protocols pass on matching production bytes; all four memory controls reject after complete protocols. Two unchanged cold-read minimum assertions remain RED. Phase 5/6/W26 remain open.

root.mechanism: Cold fill already bulk-builds the row tree. The provider measurer nevertheless called nextCuratedAfter for each ROW, traversing the row tree twice per successor, and block resolution repeated entryByLabel plus ID/header decoding even for the current known ROW. Every small asynchronous physical read also gave the unchanged settling sampler another opportunity to run GC. There was no repeated serialization of the whole preceding prefix.
root.fix: One fill-owned source and a monotonically advancing curated-entry iterator supply successor metadata. A response plan reuses its current pinned part metadata for local blocks, preserving indexed lookup for external references. A single fill-owned positional reader batches small ROW ranges into two fixed 16 KiB windows, clipped to that snapshot durableEnd. Frame and piece CRC validation, large-unit reads, format generation keys and estimator contract are unchanged.
root.tokenizer: The real legacy encoder initializes once per fresh diagnostic process at the first 40-row estimate, then zero times at 400/4000. Approved kept/stripped repeat-delta counting remains 4N+2 registry estimates and tokenizer encodes, not per-row model initialization. The body is normalized once per unit per length/token-format pass; both kept/stripped conversions remain required. Distinct base length and estimator-key formats still require separate cold passes.
root.ownership: No history-sized row/ID/unit-length cache, full-file buffer, new normalizer or production temporary file. The two byte windows retain at most 32768 payload bytes, with a fixed two-entry metadata array; no decoded historical ROW payload is retained there. A cache miss can transiently coexist with the two old windows, at most 49152 window payload bytes before replacement. Returned ranges are copies so a consumer cannot pin retired windows through tiny subarrays. Existing shared ID caches remain separately bounded at 65536 charged bytes each; this does not establish aggregate capacity across arbitrary pins/views/requests.
root.scope: Cold base fill is a sequential metadata/unit pass; mutations retain existing affected indexed lookups and request summaries. Warm planning evidence is limited to completed assertions: later warm checks after the two failed cold-read minimums did not execute in those invocations.

fixedWorkingState.scope: Per fill-owned snapshot positional reader. Adjacent ROW bytes can be prefetched and retained, so this is additional fixed working state, not zero extra bytes or only current-unit bytes. Large reads bypass the cache and retain their ordinary conversion-unit size. Separate requests/fills own separate capacities; no aggregate bound is established.
fixedWorkingState.idCaches: Existing BoundedIdNodeCache instances each charge at most 65536 bytes independently. The diagnostic maximum charged cache was 910 bytes; this is not an aggregate heap proof.
fixedWorkingState.lifecycle: formatFill.snapshotOf creates the only windowed access for the fill. fillSlot finally closes the prepared successor iterator and then the borrowed snapshot, including measure/finish failure. Fill-local source/reader closures are not published into the HTTP body or format registration. Windows have no explicit zeroing/clear method: their storage becomes unreachable with the fill context. Snapshot close rejects future leased reads; do not infer immediate physical reclamation from close alone. Existing cancel/error reader-lifetime tests pass.
fixedWorkingState.validation: Only requested ROW frame/range accesses use these windows. Durable-end/range checks and frame/piece CRC paths remain in place. Prefetched neighboring bytes are not represented as verified ROWs. Bypass reads are not truncated. Wrong-offset, torn-tail, malformed-row and original-failure tests remain enabled.

protocol.name: original-three-pair-native
protocol.warmup: Only small prepare/estimate/HTTP send, after code aging. Large remains cold for its first measured send. Source setup precedes aging exactly as before; no native large pre-fill.
protocol.algorithm: Per-send peaks use max(0, settledReading - previous quiet baseline). Growth is median(three large peaks) - median(three small peaks), signed and compared <=1048576 independently for heap and ArrayBuffers. Retention is max(Theil-Sen slope of six heaps *5, Theil-Sen slope of six ArrayBuffer readings *5), compared <=1048576. Endpoint growth is reported, not judged. No offset/noise subtraction. Partial pairs have no original gate verdict.
protocol.route: For each successful send require exactly one actual NativeChatBody stream, exactly one production estimate with positive token count, and zero WireBodySpool creates/PromptEstimatorFiles writes. Exactly one HTTP request. Fixed independent legacy-converter hash/bytes and Content-Length. Retention sends enforce route and stable hash in the probe.
protocol.ownership: Provider probe owns production HistoryService/journal selections; persistent ROW commits stream one row at a time. An eager test-only converter oracle runs in the parent outside measurement. No expected whole-body buffer enters provider memory. Separate sink incrementally hashes HTTP bytes and holds scalar metadata only.

measurements.meaning: 40/400/4000 rows have identical fixed payload and one-row-at-a-time commits. Physical read counts, requested bytes and actual returned bytes come from the real descriptor seam, not Darwin fsRead counters. Snapshot, cold preparation, estimate and replay are separated. Replay is not HTTP; actual HTTP evidence is in the protocol lanes and independent golden/direct/public tests. Diagnostic timings have instrumentation and no memory sampler; protocol costs include the original GC/sampling and HTTP schedule. The first encoder initialization is included and reported separately, never moved outside the protocol window.

writeAccounting.physicalWriteCalls: NOT_COLLECTED in the existing descriptor diagnostics. File size is not a write-call count; Darwin zero counters are not substituted.
writeAccounting.scope: Actual first-large native journalBytesAdded are recorded; later warm sends add zero. Before/final final-file sizes use different diagnostic session identities. They are reported directly, not claimed to prove identical write calls or total written bytes.

controls.regression: Both original <=10N+100 and added <=2N+100 physical-read assertions remain enabled. Body bytes are exactly 989N+126 and estimated tokens exactly 200N+15. Restoring old traversal fails the former bound; disabling the window fails the latter. No wall-clock test threshold was added.
